Projects.name: Kikoff
Projects.desription: Designed and developed an identity verification backend for onboarding workflows serving 250K+ users monthly, collaborating with vendor engineers and Compliance on multi-stage verification logic. Validated the integration through shadow runs, Snowflake analysis, and A/B testing. Resolved an onboarding issue affecting approximately 3,700 users, enabling additional identity checks and reducing manual review time. Halved operator time for internal credit-reporting uploads through asynchronous, concurrent Sidekiq processing and clearer upload status in the UI. Built an NFC-enabled office-navigation platform with interactive maps and meeting-room search, partnering with Infrastructure and Information Security to enable access without a corporate VPN.

Projects.name: ScholarSAT
Projects.desription: Developed a Next.js and TypeScript application for a tutoring-center client, supporting student score tracking, parent progress viewing, and administrative workflows with Firestore. Implemented role-based access with Firebase Auth and custom admin approval, alongside a question bank supporting manual entry and PDF/HTML ingestion.

Projects.name: QuickFi
Projects.desription: Reduced transaction bottleneck detection time by 80% by replacing manual data analysis with a natural-language query interface for cycle-time insights and performance outliers. Designed an OpenAI API integration with tiered context injection, grounding responses in precomputed transaction metrics. Built a Python ETL pipeline using pandas to process 1K+ transactions, computing stage durations, aggregations, and IQR-based outlier detection across lender and dealer scopes.

Projects.name: Data Validation System
Projects.desription: Built and deployed a scalable, automated post-processing validation system using AWS Glue with Apache Spark, EventBridge, and CDK, processing 15K+ daily records in production workflows serving 1M+ customers. Developed schema enforcement, null detection, and field-specific validation rules, reducing debugging time by 20%+ through early error detection. Reduced data quality-related on-call tickets by 25%, improving pipeline reliability for 3+ downstream teams.

Projects.name: Industrial Technology Research Institute
Projects.desription: Built a local RAG chatbot pipeline using pdfplumber for PDF extraction, SentenceTransformer embeddings, a FAISS vector store of 30K+ vectors, Llama3, LangChain, and Streamlit. Crawled and preprocessed 900+ disease-related documents from web and PDF sources, integrating a document retriever and LLM re-ranker to improve answer accuracy by 50%. Evaluated chatbot accuracy using hospital-sourced workflows to improve reliability and contextual accuracy.

Projects.name: SmartPantry
Projects.desription: During a 36-hour hackathon, my team developed SmartPantry, a mobile application aimed at reducing food waste by helping users manage their groceries more efficiently. Built using Expo React Native and Appwrite, the app allows users to track their ingredients, receive expiration reminders, and get recipe suggestions based on what they have on hand. SmartPantry empowers users to minimize waste and make meal planning easier, aligning with our mission to address the global issue of food waste.

Projects.name: InteliEQ Website Redesign
Projects.desription: Redesigned the marketing website for InteliEQ, a cleantech startup at the intersection of indoor air quality, human health, and energy intelligence. Built a modern, multi-page responsive site using Next.js to better communicate the company's mission and showcase their technology to decision-makers in healthcare and commercial environments.

Projects.name: RAG System with Local LLM
Projects.desription: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system that allows users to upload and analyze unlimited documents using a locally hosted LLM (Llama3). The system enables efficient document retrieval and context-aware chatbot responses, leveraging FAISS for vector storage and LangChain for seamless integration.

Projects.name: AguaClara
Projects.desription:
As the Web Development Lead for AguaClara Cornell, I led the redesign and implementation of the team’s website, which resulted in a 75% increase in page views. I designed a scalable content management system (CMS) using JavaScript and JSON to manage data for over 60 team members. I also authored detailed technical documentation and oversaw the deployment and maintenance of the site, setting up continuous integration to streamline updates and ensure efficient maintenance. 
 In my current role as a Backend Developer on the POST subteam, I am working on the integration of  AWS Amplify to enable real-time and offline data synchronization for the backend of AguaDatos, ensuring data reliability in areas with limited network access.

Projects.name: ConsenCity
Projects.desription: During a 24-hour hackathon (Big Red Hacks!), my team developed a web application to improve transparency in local government policymaking. Our project, which facilitated public access to policy information, won the best software award for its innovation and impact on civic engagement.

Projects.name: Glimpse
Projects.desription: Glimpse is a website/app designed to make it easy for friends to stay connected and updated on each other's lives. By signing up with your friend group, you will receive a monthly email with prompts about your lives. Simply respond to the prompts and share any photos or videos you like. Friends can log into their accounts to view their memories over time and customize prompts.
